info.title: Le Bizzarre Avventure di JoJo: Stardust Crusaders (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il protagonista Jonathan Joestar, nell'Inghilterra alla fine del diciannovesimo secolo, è il figlio del ricco lord George Joestar I. Questi adotta Dio Brando, coetaneo di Jonathan e figlio di Dario, uno sbandato che lo stava derubando a seguito di un incidente e che lui crede gli abbia salvato la vita. Dio, la cui vera indole è ambiziosa e perversa, vuole impadronirsi del casato dei Joestar, prima privando Jonathan di ogni amicizia e affetto, e poi cercando di uccidere il genitore adottivo con lo stesso veleno con cui aveva ucciso il padre. Scoperto e messo alle corde, usa su di sé la Maschera di Pietra, un portentoso artefatto di origine azteca in grado di trasformare l'uomo in un vampiro. Per affrontarlo, Jonathan apprenderà la tecnica delle onde concentriche dal misterioso avventuriero Will A. Zeppeli, grazie alla quale potrà scontrarsi contro zombie e cavalieri medievali evocati da Dio Brando, tra i quali Jack lo Squartatore, Bruford e Tarkus, e Doobie lo spettro, fino allo scontro finale con il nemico. Alla fine Jonathan muore tragicamente, portando con sé (nell'esplosione finale della nave che avrebbe dovuto condurlo in viaggio di nozze) la testa, ancora viva e pericolosa, di un Dio Brando ormai disperato che cerca di appropriarsi del corpo del suo rivale. Entrambi periscono nell'esplosione e nell'affondamento della nave. O almeno così sembra...

episodes.title: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
episodes.synopsis: In 1987, in Japan, a boy named Jotaro Kujo has willingly turned himself into jail, refusing to leave. Jotaro's mother, Holy, requests help from her father, Joseph Joestar, who travels to Japan alongside an acquaintance, Muhammad Avdol.

episodes.title: Who Will Be the Judge!?
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro heads to school and encounters a mysterious transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin.

episodes.title: The Curse of Dio
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro is able to defeat Kakyoin. He takes the wounded Kakyoin back to his house, hoping to get some information about DIO.

episodes.title: Tower of Gray
episodes.synopsis: If they do not defeat DIO within 50 days, Holy could die - Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding. While on the plane, they run into another one of DIO's assassins.

episodes.title: Silver Chariot
episodes.synopsis: DIO's next assassin, Polnareff, attacks Jotaro and crew, Avdol faces him with his Magician's Red.

episodes.title: Dark Blue Moon
episodes.synopsis: With a new person in their party, they head to Singapore with the boat the Speedwagon Foundation provided them, during their journey Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.

episodes.title: Strength
episodes.synopsis: A giant ship shows itself . On board, they realize they can't seem to find a crew, but an orangutan.

episodes.title: The Devil
episodes.synopsis: Arrived at Singapore, Jotaro's group stay at hotel individualy. A new Stand owner who is afraid as "Devo the Cursed" is awaited Polnareff in his room. Devo's Stand increases its power as its user's hatred toward opponent increases. Polnareff gets into desperate situation as he starts fighting front. Does Polnareff have a chance to win the battle from Devo who keeps attacking him with cruel and brutal way?

episodes.title: Yellow Temperance
episodes.synopsis: Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.

episodes.title: The Emperor and The Hanged Man, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: The group travels to India. In a restaurant Polnareff is attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.

episodes.title: The Emperor and The Hanged Man, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: In an effort to save Polnareff, Avdol is injured by the enemy. Then J. Geil's Stand, Hanged Man attacks.

episodes.title: The Empress
episodes.synopsis: The group heads toward Varanasi. On the way, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.

episodes.title: Wheel of Fortune
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others head toward Pakistan in a car. Polnareff is driving the car on a very dangerous mountain road, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan. However, they decide to find an inn at a nearby village because of the dense fog they suddenly hit. The village they get to is rather quiet and all of the inhabitants seem rather odd.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Polnareff finally realizes that Enya is another assassin from DIO. He tries to warn the others, but Enya's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he is pursued. The whole village had already been under Enya's control.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: After surviving Enya's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Steely Dan. Following DIO's orders, Steely Dan ruthlessly kills Enya in front of them. Jotaro and the others can't help but feel conflicted about that happening, and end up in a battle with Steely Dan.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Steely Dan's Stand, Lovers, has entered Joseph's brain. Dan puts himself at an advantage, with having Joseph's life on the line, and tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey. Meanwhile, Kakyoin and Polnareff also enter Joseph's brain with their Stands and find the Stand that is using brain cells as food.

episodes.title: The Sun
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others continue their journey through the desert, trying to get to Cairo. They travel with camels and can't shake the feeling that someone is following them, but no one is in sight. Traveling in the killer heat, they realize that it's still bright out at 8pm and the sun is actually rising rather than setting.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Kakyoin is dreaming and dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream, he witnesses Death cut down a dog. Kakyoin wakes up screaming, but can't remember what his bad dream was about.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is suspicious, but that backfires, and his friends start to doubt his sanity. Kakyoin then tries to convince them that he's not crazy, and shows them his arm that has "Baby Stand" carved into it... but that just makes them believe he really is crazy. Kakyoin then tries to use his Stand to attack, but is knocked out by Polnareff. Eventually, Jotaro and the others wake up in the nightmare and the truth finally comes out.

episodes.title: Judgment, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: While on an island on the edge of the Red Sea where Muhammad Avdol's father is said to live, Polnareff uncovers a magic lamp and its genie Cameo offers him three wishes, although all is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Judgment, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Polnareff must find out a way to escape the attacks of Cameo and his Stand Judgement who has apparently turned his sister Sherry and Avdol into zombies.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of travel. Through the Red Sea, they try to head toward Egypt where DIO awaits. Using the sonar to detect any threats on the outside, the submarine quietly dives in. They however realize that if they're attacked underwater, there is nowhere to escape, so they are on their guard. Finally, when they are about to surface, a coffee mug that was in the cabin transforms and cuts off Joseph's artificial hand.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: The group must find a way off of the submarine and away from the attacks of High Priestess.

info.title: The Wonderland
info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata su Akane, una ragazza con poca stima di se stessa che verrà coinvolta in un'importante e inaspettata missione. Il giorno prima del suo compleanno, infatti, incontrerà un misterioso alchimista di nome Hippocrates e il suo studente Pipo, che le riveleranno di essere in missione per salvare il mondo. La meta del loro viaggio è Wonderland e Akane diverrà presto la persona più qualificata per salvare questo strano mondo magico.

episodes.title: Let`s Use Our Resources with Care / Horror! Bloody Mansion Slaughter Dance
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Risu went out to the town of Berith to track down the Cross-Eyes’ hideout! Those Cross-Eyes guys live pretty modestly, you know.

episodes.title: Meoto Zenzai / Mastema Subnade / The Tragic Tale of the Cross-Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Haru the Devil has shown up. What’s she doing chatting it up with Humans? Meanwhile, the lizard guy and Nikaido have arrived in Mastema.

episodes.title: Sweet Home / Shining Youth / Memories Keep Circling Round and Round / Come Back Home
episodes.synopsis: Seems En’s trying to make a buck from some no-good mushrooms again, and it looks like the lizard guy remembered something important.

episodes.title: Golden Beetles Are Rich / Cute Butcher / Door to the Past
episodes.synopsis: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes.title: Meeting in the Rain / Travel Companions / Final Night for Two
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes.title: Farewell, Caiman / Memory Bubbles
episodes.synopsis: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes.title: My Secret Plan / Cross-Eye Expedition / Deformed Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes.title: Chaos Shock / Black Box / Room 501
episodes.synopsis: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes.title: Mosh Pit / Cross-Eyes in the News
episodes.synopsis: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes.title: Lucky Jerk / Advanced Magic
episodes.synopsis: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes.title: Ballad of the Happy Destruction / Question & Answer
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

info.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
info.synopsis: Ephtal è un ragazzo privo di talento che muore ben due volte. La prima volta si reincarna in un mondo alternativo dove dedica tutta la sua vita allo studio della magia per scoprire di non aver alcun talento per essa e morire d'angoscia. Successivamente si reincarna nuovamente ben 400 anni dopo la sua "prima morte". Avendo conservato la memoria e il suo potere, decide ancora una volta di puntare alla vetta della magia.

episodes.title: Prologue
episodes.synopsis: A sage with no magical talent begins his second reincarnation.

episodes.title: Lost Technology
episodes.synopsis: Eftal learns that magic in this new era is far weaker than he thought.

episodes.title: Overkill
episodes.synopsis: Eftal's father sets out on a plot to kill the crown prince, and Eftal gets involved.

episodes.title: Seek Freedom
episodes.synopsis: Eftal happens upon a slave and frees her from her wicked master.

episodes.title: Through Her Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Eftal is reunited with his old student.

episodes.title: Dear Eftal
episodes.synopsis: Eftal battles Merlin and shows off his strongest spell.

episodes.title: Master Smile
episodes.synopsis: Eftal becomes a student at a new magic academy.

episodes.title: No Escape
episodes.synopsis: Anastasia steals Raikiri and escapes to her real master.

episodes.title: Let Me Pay
episodes.synopsis: Anastasia turns to Eftal for help against her master.

episodes.title: Veiled Truth
episodes.synopsis: Anastasia and Merlin are afflicted by a curse that turns them into little children.

episodes.title: False Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Eftal battles the contract beast to free Anastasia.

episodes.title: I Am Eftal
episodes.synopsis: Eftal finishes the fight to free Anastasia.

episodes.title: Twi-Yaba
episodes.synopsis: Questo episodio speciale raccoglie una serie di brevi capitoli che approfondiscono il rapporto tra Ichikawa e Yamada, originariamente realizzati per una nota piattaforma social. Sarà un’occasione per vedere come il rapporto tra i due fa passi avanti anche al di là degli eventi narrati dalla serie!

info.title: Overgeared (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel mondo reale, Youngwoo Shin è un ragazzo sommerso dai debiti e considerato da tutti un fallito. La sua unica fuga è Satisfy, il gioco di realtà virtuale più famoso del pianeta, dove gioca con l'avatar Grid. Anche lì, però, la sfortuna lo perseguita, lasciandolo bloccato ai livelli più bassi. Tutto cambia quando scopre per caso un libro leggendario e sblocca una classe unica e mai vista: Il Discendente di Pagma. Anche se il suo livello viene resettato a 1, Grid ottiene un potere straordinario: la capacità di forgiare e soprattutto equipaggiare qualsiasi arma o armatura del gioco, ignorando ogni restrizione di livello o classe. Mentre gli altri giocatori puntano su magie e abilità di combattimento, Grid deciderà di scalare le classifiche mondiali e diventare il giocatore più forte di tutti sfruttando un'unica, devastante strategia: il potere assoluto degli oggetti.
